comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Cutting tools and consumer first aid kits sold through retailers; not a hospital medical device business.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Generic injectable and inhaled drugs made from active ingredients; a pharmaceutical business, not devices.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Bone growth stimulators, biologics and cartilage implants for orthopedics; differs from Teleflex's vascular, interventional and anesthesia lines.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Wearable glucose sensors bought mainly by diabetic patients through pharmacies and reimbursement; a consumer-facing diabetes business.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Designs and sells hospital-used surgical instruments and devices through its own sales teams to surgeons; overlaps Teleflex's surgical lines.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Dental implants, aligners and orthodontic products sold to dental professionals; a different end market.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Single-use blood processing disposables and surgical blood salvage devices sold to hospitals and blood centers; similar hospital device model.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Prescription buprenorphine medicines for addiction treatment; a drug business, not medical devices.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Neurosurgical and surgical instruments and implants sold to hospitals and surgeons through direct sales; matches Teleflex's surgical device model.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Branded non-opioid injectable drugs plus a nerve-pain device; drug-led business, unlike Teleflex's device lines.

comps.label: C11
comps.reason: Mainly home CPAP sleep apnea therapy sold via home equipment dealers and patients; differs from Teleflex's hospital anesthesia and respiratory devices.

comps.label: C12
comps.reason: Diversified mix of medical tapes, dental products, health IT software and coding services; much broader than Teleflex's device focus.

comps.label: C13
comps.reason: Sterilizers, surgical tables and contract sterilization services; capital equipment and services rather than Teleflex's disposable and therapy devices.

comps.label: C14
comps.reason: Lymphedema and venous compression devices used at home and rented to patients; a different therapy business.

comps.label: C15
comps.reason: Spine fusion implants and bone graft products for spine surgery; orthopedic implants differ from Teleflex's vascular and interventional lines.
